purpose: Compact index of retained primary sources for the finance-research candidate records. Derived from .local/finance-evidence/retrieval-manifest.json (2026-10-31). Raw source texts are retained only in the git-ignored .local/finance-evidence/ directory and are NOT reproduced in this dataset.

access_status_vocabulary.raw_download: File fetched directly from the primary URL (curl/HTTPS with normal TLS verification) and retained byte-for-byte; extraction retained alongside.
access_status_vocabulary.rendered_dom: Browser-rendered DOM innerText captured from the primary page; secondary to retained PDFs for clause text.
access_status_vocabulary.retained_tool_extraction: Text retained from a tool-mediated retrieval of the primary URL. NOT raw HTML: the direct raw fetch failed, and the retained artifact is the tool's text output, not the original bytes.
access_status_vocabulary.not_retained: Direct fetch attempt failed; no raw bytes retained. Documents an access limitation, never usable as evidence of a document's absence.

verification_vocabulary.section_checked: Cited sections/locators were read in the retained extraction during this task (2026-10-31) before being cited by any candidate record.
verification_vocabulary.string_checked: Cited strings and their occurrence counts were checked in the retained extraction during this task (2026-10-31).
verification_vocabulary.not_relied: Not used as evidence for any candidate record (retained-and-hashed artifacts kept only for provenance, or access-limitation records documenting a failed fetch).
